name: Tim Price
researchKeywords: social inequity, deaths of despair, vulnerable populations, neonatal outcomes
bio: Dr Tim Price, PhD is a Research Associate in the Health Inequalities Team. He studies health inequalities as a matter of social justice and focuses on the social inequities that disproportionately affect vulnerable populations.
researchFocus: Tim's doctoral research explored stakeholder and community understandings of inequalities in deaths related to drugs, suicide and alcohol in Middlesbrough and South Tyneside. He has also supported research on unwarranted variation in neonatal healthcare outcomes.

professionalRoles.title: Research support role in neonatal healthcare outcomes
